title: Kotihoidon käynnit ja asiakkaat 2025
inspection_scope: Pages 1–2: counts, age-specific coverage, definitions. Page 20: reporting completeness limitations. Not a digitisation of annual chart values or all regional tables.
definition: Annual client: at least one home visit during the year. Regular client: home visits on at least six days within 60 days during the year.
scope: Publicly organised homecare, home nursing and included home-service records; excludes privately organised homecare.
quality_limits: More comprehensive purchased-service reporting contributes to the observed increase. Purchased-service visits remain incompletely reported in almost all wellbeing-services counties.
Åland data are partly incomplete due to an information-system change.
Two simultaneous nurses at a visit now count as one visit; visit counts are not staff working hours.
internal_published_share_discrepancy: Regular share of all clients is 67% on page 1 and 68% on page 2. Neither share is used in this supplement; use exact counts and the separately published age-specific coverage.
historical_comparison: No direct comparison to the unrevised 2024 report; any change uses the 2025 report own comparison.
